episode.description_intro: Join Dino's birthday hide and seek! Can you find the farm animals by their sounds — moo, quack, baa, and more? A fun animal sounds adventure for toddlers and preschoolers!
learning_points: Learn 7 animal sounds: moo, quack, baa, cock-a-doodle-doo, ribbit, hoot, woof
Practice hide and seek and listening skills
Copy fun movements: hop, dance, spin, flap, stomp, wiggle

episode.ask: Can you help me find them?

finds.action_line: The cow can dance! Can you dance too?
The duck can flap! Can you flap too?
The sheep can hop! Can you hop too?
The dog can stomp! Can you stomp too?
The rooster can flap! Can you flap too?
The frog can hop! Can you hop too?
The owl can spin! Can you spin too?

lines: Let us hop and clap and spin,
Stomp your feet and jump up high,
March and stretch and wiggle round,
Flap your arms up so high,
Hop and clap and spin in a ring,

finale: Thank you for finding my friends!
Thank you, friends! I love you!
episode.teaser_line: Next time, a new friend comes to play!
